beats.text: With the monsoon season, no army could march. Rama and Lakshmana waited in a cave on Mount Prasravana for four long months.
Rivers flooded, lightning cracked over the forest, and the roads disappeared under water.
Every night, Rama grieved for Sita. The storms only made it harder. Every peacock's cry, every flash of lightning reminded him of her.
Lakshmana sat beside him. 'Grief steals strength,' he said. 'Hold on, brother. We will find her.'
Meanwhile, Sugriva fell into comfort, with music, wine and his queens, and forgot his promise.
Autumn came. The sky cleared. But no army gathered.
When the rains ended, an angry Lakshmana came to remind him. He twanged his bow, and the whole city shook.
Wise Queen Tara came out first and calmed him. Sugriva was ashamed, and ordered every monkey army in the world to gather.
